## Load libraries and data

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("survival")
library("broom")

cancer_data_augmented <- read_csv(file = "../data/03_cancer_data_augmented.csv", 
                        show_col_types = FALSE)
```

### Kaplan-Meier survival estimate

```{r}
# Comes from https://www.emilyzabor.com/survival-analysis-in-r.html

cancer_data_augmented <- cancer_data_augmented |>
  mutate(
    event = if_else(vital_status == "dead", 1, 0)
  )

surv_fit <- cancer_data_augmented |> survfit(Surv(time = follow_up_months, event = event) ~ estrogen_treatment, data = _)

```

```{r}
# Using broom-package with tidy() function
surv_data <- surv_fit |>
  tidy()

surv_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = estimate, colour = strata)) +
  geom_step()
  
```
